findings.actual_failure: Reproduced over a fixture store seeded with two defect captures whose statements share the first 60 slug chars: after the drain, docs/product/captured/ is empty — the first item carries terminal disposition routed while its materialized artifact was deleted by the second item's failed transaction, and the re-drain cannot recreate it because the capture is no longer open. findings.observation: transact_route's rollback_partial_state unlinks the captured-item target whenever its bytes differ from the current item's expected bytes. _captured_item_target derives the filename from the statement slug truncated to 60 characters, so two captures whose statements share that prefix, or a pre-existing file at the same slug, collide: default_materialize raises FileExistsError, run_intake_transaction invokes the rollback, and the rollback deletes the differing pre-existing file — which can only be a complete artifact written by a prior committed transaction or by the normal capture path, never a partial write of this one.
findings.reachable_path: drain → transact_route → run_intake_transaction → materialize raises FileExistsError on the byte-differing existing target → _recover_partial_state → rollback_partial_state → target.unlink() of the other item's committed artifact.

findings.actual_failure: Reproduced over a fixture store holding one clean capture and one consistent dirty merged record: both read_open_captures and drain raise KnowledgeStoreError; the clean capture is never offered, no report is produced, and nothing is held. findings.observation: read_open_captures reads through knowledge_store._read_events, whose per-event validation re-runs the full capture-request validator including assert_persistable_text's eight patterns. A § D10 merge-path record whose free text carries a privacy-violating or instruction-shaped string therefore raises KnowledgeStoreError for the whole read before any offer is assembled. Because the store's read scan applies the same patterns over a superset of the fields rerun_prose_controls scans, a record that survives the reader can never fail the re-run: routing_input == refused is unreachable through drain(), and the § D4 re-run is dead code end-to-end.

findings.observation: store_terminal_dispositions enumerates the store's partitions through KS._observation_partitions(root) with no quarantine collector (promotion_drain.py:581 — the _Quarantine it creates is passed only to _events_excluding_invalid, never to the enumeration), while read_open_captures reaches the same enumeration through KS.pending_page, which passes a quarantine collector. In knowledge_store._observation_partitions, a partition file whose name fails validation or that is a symlink/non-regular file raises when no collector is given, but is excluded and reported as quarantined 'unsafe' when one is. The operator or verification suite then derives the promoted/pruned counts through store_terminal_dispositions (AC-0019/AC-0020), and it raises KnowledgeStoreError instead of returning counts.
